sentence: One two-stage survey models AI capabilities as inputs to the firm's adaptive response to market change and finds that this response lifts firm performance and innovation
passage: [Sullivan & Fosso Wamba (2024), p. 1] "Our research employs a two-stage design, surveying IT and business executives from firms that have adopted AI." / "This research examines how AI-powered capabilities can bring value to organizations by enhancing their Adaptive Response to Market Changes (ARMC)." / "we find that ARMC positively influences firm performance and innovation."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly confirms the two-stage survey design, the examination of AI capabilities as inputs enhancing adaptive response, and the finding that this response positively influences firm performance and innovation.
